notes: EIA's file has no per-value estimate flag: each series has a frequency f (all "A", annual) and "--" marks no value. A year counts as full when the series was last updated after that year ended; each country's newest full year is kept.
Series with no figure in the last 10 years of the file (newest year 2025) are dropped as former countries or stale.

Hand check 2026-11-23 (a separate script read INTL.txt, not the DataTool): all 210 values equal the newest numeric year of the country's series; the top 5 producers are USA, RUS, SAU, CAN and IRQ (2025), as the plan expected. The 8 codes with no unit in the boundary set (MTQ, GIB, GLP, WAK, USIQ, NLDA, REU, GUF) all have 0 in 2025, so they are recorded under dropped (ruling R16) and not listed in the app.

User-Agent: the zip answered HTTP 200 to the app's User-Agent on 2026-11-23; EIA's bulk-files page (https://www.eia.gov/opendata/bulk/) answered 403 to it and to curl's default, so the page text was not read. The citation links https://www.eia.gov/international/ (HTTP 200).
